english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a soft object deflating or collapsing, and for a plan, business, or operation suddenly failing.

exampleSentences.english: The shop may collapse before the end of this month.
exampleSentences.traditional: 間舖頭捱唔過呢個月就會冧。
exampleSentences.jyutping: gaan1 pou3 tau4 ngaai4 m4 gwo3 ni1 go3 jyut6 zau6 wui5 lam6

english.note: Use this colloquial verb when a structure, organization, or undertaking collapses or goes under.

exampleSentences.english: That company could fall apart at any time.
exampleSentences.jyutping: gaan1 gung1 si1 ceoi4 si4 wui5 lam6
